options.name: artifacts_in_pool
options.display_name: Number of artifacts in the pool
options.description: How many artifacts should be in the item pool

options.name: artifacts_required_percentage
options.display_name: Percentage of artifacts required to goal
options.description: How many of the artifacts in the pool you need to goal in percent

options.name: max_characters
options.description: How many characters should at most be included in the generated seed

options.name: starting_characters
options.description: How many characters should be available at the start

options.name: character_level_checks
options.description: How many level up checks should be included per character

options.name: jnpr_enabled
options.description: If characters from the team JNPR DLC should be added to the item pool

options.name: characters_disabled
options.description: Characters in this list will never appear in the generated seed

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: death_link_receive_mode
options.description:
How incoming deathlinks should be handled
"single" downs a single random player
"all" downs all players

options.name: death_link_send_mode
options.description:
When death links should be sent out
"single" sends a death link whenever any player goes down
"all" sends a death link when all players are downed

options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
